label: Lv6Start_00
EU_English:
To think that you've made it this far.
Aren't you a persistent little thing?
EU_French:
Et dire que tu es arrivé jusqu'ici.
Tu es très tenace.
EU_German:
⟦MSBT:0E000000020002006300⟧Dass du so weit gekommen bist... Was
bist du nur für ein zähes Kerlchen!⟦MSBT:0E000000020002006400⟧
EU_Italian:
E pensare che sei arrivato fin qui...
Non ti arrendi tanto facilmente, vero?
EU_Spanish:
Mira quién ha logrado llegar hasta
aquí. Debo admitir que tienes agallas.
TR_Turkish:
Buralara kadar geldiğine inanamıyorum.
Ne kadar da inatçısın!

label: Lv6Start_01
EU_English: But even you will kneel before us.
EU_French:
Mais toi aussi, tu t'inclineras bientôt
devant nous.
EU_German:
Doch auch du wirst vor
uns niederknien.
EU_Italian:
Ma non potrai fare altro che
arrenderti anche tu.
TR_Turkish:
Ama sen bile önümüzde
diz çökeceksin.

label: Lv6Start_02
EU_English:
I, Taranza, cannot allow you to
interfere with Queen Sectonia's plans.
EU_French:
Tu ne dois pas interférer avec
les plans de la Reine Sectonia.
EU_German:
Ich, Taranza, kann dich nicht Königin
Sectonias Pläne durchkreuzen lassen.
EU_Italian:
⟦MSBT:0E000000020002005F00⟧Io, Taranza, non ti permetterò di
interferire con i piani di Queen Sectonia!⟦MSBT:0E000000020002006400⟧
EU_Spanish:
Pues yo, Taraña, evitaré que arruines
los planes de la Reina Sectonia.
KR_Korean:
여왕 세크토니아님을 방해하는 짓은
나, 타란자가 용서하지 않겠다.
TR_Turkish:
Ben, Örümza, Kraliçe Sectonia'nın
planlarına karışmana izin veremem.

label: Lv6Start_03
EU_English:
Let me guess: you're here to save the
hero of the lower world.
EU_French:
Tu es venu sauver ce piètre héros
du monde d'en bas, c'est ça ?
EU_German:
⟦MSBT:0E000000020002006300⟧Lass mich raten: Du bist hier, um den 
Helden der Niederen Welt zu retten.⟦MSBT:0E000000020002006400⟧
EU_Italian:
Lasciami indovinare: sei qui per
salvare l'eroe del mondo inferiore.
EU_Spanish:
Así que has venido a salvar al
debilucho héroe del mundo inferior...
KR_Korean:
너는 이 녀석을…
하계의 용사를 구하려는 것이겠지?
TR_Turkish:
Tahmin edeyim: Alt dünyanın
kahramanını kurtarmaya geldin.

label: Lv6Start_04
EU_English:
The people of this land thought they
were clever.
EU_French:
On dirait que les gens de ce monde
ne réfléchissent pas beaucoup.
EU_German:
⟦MSBT:0E000000020002006400⟧Die Bewohner dieses Landes hielten
sich für schlau.⟦MSBT:0E000000020002006400⟧
EU_Italian:
Da queste parti si credono
intelligenti, pare.
EU_Spanish:
Los habitantes de este mundo
se creyeron muy listos.
KR_Korean:
이 나라 녀석들은
어쩌면 이렇게도 어리석은지…
TR_Turkish:
Bu diyarın insanları kendilerini
zeki sandılar.

label: Lv6Start_05
EU_English:
They thought they could use the
Dreamstalk to save their world.
EU_French:
Ils pensaient que la Tige des rêves
les sauverait.
EU_German:
⟦MSBT:0E000000020002006100⟧Sie dachten, dass sie die Traumranke
zur Rettung ihrer Welt nutzen könnten.⟦MSBT:0E000000020002006400⟧
EU_Italian:
Pensavano di usare la Pianta dei
Sogni per salvare il mondo inferiore.
EU_Spanish:
¡⟦MSBT:0E000000020002006300⟧Pensaron que podrían usar la Planta
de ensueño para salvarse!⟦MSBT:0E000000020002006400⟧
KR_Korean:
월드 트리를 사용해서
하계에 도움을 요청하리라고…
TR_Turkish:
Rüya Sarmaşığı'nı kullanarak
dünyalarını kurtarabileceklerini sandılar.

label: Lv6Start_06
EU_English: But I saw right through their plan.
EU_French: Je connais leur plan depuis le début.
EU_Spanish: Pero a⟦MSBT:0E000000020002006200⟧diviné su plan desde el principio.⟦MSBT:0E000000020002006400⟧

label: Lv6Start_07
EU_French:
Bien, puisque tu as pris la peine
de venir ici...
EU_German: Aber da du nun schon hier bist...
EU_Italian:
Ma visto che hai fatto così tanta
strada per arrivare fin qui...
KR_Korean: 이곳까지 온 너에게 멋진 선물을 주지…

label: Lv6Start_08
EU_English: I'll give you your precious hero back.
EU_French:
Je vais te le rendre,
ton précieux héros.
EU_Italian: ⟦MSBT:0E000000020002006100⟧... ti restituirò il tuo preziosissimo eroe.⟦MSBT:0E000000020002006400⟧
EU_Spanish: te devolveré a tu querido héroe.

label: Lv6Start_09
EU_English:
But he may be a little more...hostile
than you remember him!
EU_French:
Mais il pourrait être plus hostile
que dans tes souvenirs.
EU_German:
Er ist vielleicht etwas... feindseliger,
als du ihn in Erinnerung hast!
EU_Italian:
Credo che sarà solo un briciolo più...
ostile di quanto tu possa ricordare.
EU_Spanish:
Aunque puede que te parezca
un poco más... ¡violento!
TR_Turkish:
Ama hatırladığından biraz daha...
saldırgan olabilir!

label: Lv6End_00
EU_English: Wh-what is the meaning of this?!

label: Lv6End_01
EU_English: I did just as Her Majesty commanded.
EU_French: J'ai suivi les ordres de ma reine.
EU_German: Ich tat nur, was Ihre Majestät befahl.
EU_Italian:
Ho solo seguito gli ordini di Sua
Maestà.
EU_Spanish: He hecho lo que ordenó Su Majestad.
KR_Korean: 여왕님의 명령에 따라 이 용사에게 최면에 걸어

label: Lv6End_02
EU_English:
The lower world should fall to its
knees before me!
EU_French:
Le monde d'en bas se prosternera
devant moi !
EU_German:
Die Niedere Welt soll vor mir auf
die Knie fallen!
EU_Italian: Il mondo inferiore cadrà ai miei piedi!
EU_Spanish:
¡El mundo inferior debería
inclinarse ante mí!

label: Lv6End_03
EU_English:
Could... Could you be the true hero
of the lower world?
EU_French:
Ou alors... Serais-tu le vrai héros
du monde d'en bas ?
EU_German:
Kann es sein... Bist du der wahre
Held der Niederen Welt?
EU_Italian:
Sarà così? Sarai tu il coraggioso
eroe del mondo inferiore?
EU_Spanish:
A no ser que... ¡seas tú el héroe
verdadero del mundo inferior!
TR_Turkish:
Yoksa... Alt dünyanın gerçek
kahramanı sen misin?

label: Lv6End_04
EU_French: Bon sang ! Si c'est bien le cas...
EU_German: Oh nein!!! Sollte dies wahr sein...

label: Lv6End_06
EU_English:
Oh, glorious Sectonia!
Please come to my resc-
EU_French:
Ô glorieuse Sectonia !
Venez à mon sec...
EU_German:
Oh, wundervolle Sectonia!
Bitte kommt mir zu Hil--
EU_Italian:
Oh, mia splendida regina!
Vi prego, aiutat-
EU_Spanish:
¡Oh, poderosa Sectonia!
Venid a salvarme, os lo rue...
KR_Korean:
오오, 찬란한 세크토니아님!
저를 구해 주십…
TR_Turkish:
Ah, yüce Sectonia!
Lütfen beni kurtar-

label: Lv6End_10
EU_English:
I have no use for a fool who cannot
follow orders.
EU_French:
Si tu n'es pas capable d'exécuter
mes ordres, tu ne me sers à rien.
EU_German:
Einen Narren, der Befehle nicht
befolgen kann, brauche ich nicht.
EU_Italian:
Non mi serve uno sciocco come te,
incapace di eseguire un ordine.
EU_Spanish:
¿De qué me sirve un payaso que
no sabe ni seguir órdenes?
TR_Turkish:
Emirlere uymayan bir aptala
ihtiyacım yok.

label: Lv6End_11
EU_English: Now then, hero of the lower world.
EU_French:
À nous deux, héros du monde
d'en bas...
EU_German: Nun denn, Held der Niederen Welt.
EU_Italian:
E ora veniamo a te, eroe del
mondo inferiore.

label: Lv6End_12
EU_English:
You would risk your life for
this land?
EU_French:
Tu risquerais ta vie pour 
sauver ce monde ?
EU_German:
⟦MSBT:0E000000020002006400⟧Du würdest für dieses Land
dein Leben riskieren?⟦MSBT:0E000000020002006400⟧
EU_Italian:
Per quale ragione sacrifichi la tua
vita per questo mondo?
EU_Spanish:
Dime, ¿de verdad darías tu vida
por esta tierra?
TR_Turkish:
Bu diyar için
canını mı tehlikeye atarsın?

label: Lv6End_13
EU_English:
You would stand against me,
the ruler of the heavens?
EU_French:
Tu te dresserais contre moi,
qui règne sur les cieux ?
EU_German:
Du würdest mir die Stirn bieten...
Mir, der Herrscherin der Himmel?
EU_Italian:
Per quale ragione affronti me,
regina incontrastata dei cieli?
EU_Spanish:
¿Osarás enfrentarte a mí,
la reina de todos los cielos?
KR_Korean:
모든 것을 통치할 여왕에게
등을 돌릴 셈이냐…
TR_Turkish:
Gökyüzünün hükümdarı olan bana
karşı mı duracaksın?

label: Lv6End_15
EU_English:
You will bow before the
great Queen Sectonia!
EU_French:
Prosterne-toi devant la grande
Reine Sectonia !
EU_German:
Du wirst dich vor der großen
Königin Sectonia verbeugen!
EU_Italian:
Dovrai inchinarti al mio cospetto,
non avrai scelta!
EU_Spanish:
¡Te arrodillarás ante la gran
Reina Sectonia!

label: Lv6End_16
EU_French:
Ma beauté est sans pareille en
ce bas monde...
EU_Italian:
Dovrai inchinarti di fronte alla
mia bellezza, che non teme rivali!
KR_Korean:
신과 견줄 만한 미모 앞에
엎드려 경배하게 될 것이다…

label: Lv6End_17
EU_English:
And my power will crush
all that you hold dear!
EU_French:
Et mes pouvoirs détruiront tout
ce qui t'est cher !
EU_German:
Und meine Macht wird alles
zerstören, was dir lieb ist!
EU_Italian:
E il mio potere spazzerà via
quanto hai di più caro al mondo.
EU_Spanish:
¡y con mi poder destruiré todo
aquello que te importa!
TR_Turkish:
Ve gücüm, değer verdiğin
her şeyi ezecek!

label: Lv7Start_02
EU_English:
I expected as much from the hero
chosen by the Dreamstalk.
EU_French:
Je n'en attendais pas moins du
héros choisi par la Tige des rêves...
EU_German:
⟦MSBT:0E000000020002006300⟧Der von der Traumranke Auserwählte
ist so heldenhaft wie erwartet.⟦MSBT:0E000000020002006400⟧
EU_Italian:
Non potevo aspettarmi altro
dall'eroe della Pianta dei Sogni.
EU_Spanish:
No esperaba menos del héroe
elegido por la Planta de ensueño.
TR_Turkish:
Rüya Sarmaşığı'nın seçtiği
kahramandan bunu beklerdim.

label: Lv7Start_03
EU_English:
But I wonder... How will you
handle this?
EU_French:
Mais comment te débrouilleras-tu...
face à ça ?!
EU_German:
Jedoch frage ich mich... Wie wirst
du hiermit umgehen?
EU_Italian:
Tuttavia, mi chiedo...
Come riuscirai a battermi?
EU_Spanish:
Aun así, me pregunto... ¿cómo
te enfrentarás a esto?
TR_Turkish:
Ama merak ediyorum... Bununla
nasıl başa çıkacaksın?

label: Lv7Start_04
EU_French:
Tu vois, la véritable beauté...
c'est le pouvoir.
EU_Italian:
Vedi... la vera bellezza
risiede nel controllo.
EU_Spanish: ¿No conocías el poder de la belleza?

label: Lv7Start_05
EU_English:
The Dreamstalk has guided you
thus far.
EU_French:
La Tige des rêves a pu te guider
jusqu'à maintenant...
EU_German:
Die Traumranke hat dich
bis hierher geführt.
EU_Italian:
La Pianta dei Sogni
ti ha guidato fin qui.
EU_Spanish:
La Planta de ensueño te ha guiado
hasta aquí, pero...
TR_Turkish:
Rüya Sarmaşığı seni buraya kadar
yönlendirdi.

label: Lv7Start_06
EU_English: But its bloom will be your doom!
EU_French: Mais sa fleur causera ta perte !
EU_German: Doch ihre Blüte ist dein Verderben!
EU_Italian:
La sua fioritura coinciderà
con la tua fine!
TR_Turkish:
Ama çiçek açması
senin sonun olacak!

label: Lv7Start_07
EU_English:
Floralia, Dream Land, and this
entire planet!
EU_French:
Et celle de Floralia, Dream Land,
et cette planète tout entière !
EU_German:
Floralia, Dream Land und der
gesamte Planet!
EU_Italian:
Floralia, Dream Land...
e tutto il pianeta...
EU_Spanish:
Tú, Floralia, Dream Land,
¡y el mundo entero!
KR_Korean: 플로랄드와 하계… 그리고 이 천체 모두…
TR_Turkish:
Floralia, Rüya Diyarı ve
bu koskoca gezegen!

label: Lv7Start_08
EU_German: Ihr alle solltet euch geehrt fühlen.

label: Lv7Start_09
EU_English:
You will serve as my sustenance...
for eternity!
EU_French:
Vous serez ma réserve de vivres...
pour l'éternité !
EU_German:
Ihr werdet mir als Nahrung dienen...
Bis in alle Ewigkeit!
EU_Italian:
... onorati di essere la mia fonte
di sussistenza... ora e per sempre!

label: Ending_00
EU_English:
And so Floralia was saved, thanks
to Kirby's heroic efforts.
EU_French:
Ainsi, grâce aux vaillants efforts
de Kirby, Floralia fut sauvée.
EU_German:
Und so wurde Floralia dank Kirbys 
heldenhaftem Einsatz gerettet.
EU_Italian:
⟦MSBT:0E000000020002006300⟧E fu così che Floralia venne salvata,
per merito di Kirby e del suo coraggio.⟦MSBT:0E000000020002006400⟧
EU_Spanish:
Y así fue salvada Floralia, gracias
a los heroicos esfuerzos de Kirby.
KR_Korean:
커비와 친구들의 활약 덕분에
플로랄드는 평화를 되찾았습니다.
TR_Turkish:
Böylece Floralia, Kirby'nin kahramanca
çabaları sayesinde kurtuldu.

label: Ending_01
EU_English:
The People of the Sky had long lived
under the cruelties of the evil queen.
EU_French:
⟦MSBT:0E000000020002006200⟧La cruelle reine opprimait les habitants
du ciel depuis fort longtemps.⟦MSBT:0E000000020002006400⟧
EU_German:
⟦MSBT:0E000000020002006400⟧Das Himmelsvolk hatte lange unter
dem Joch der bösen Königin gelebt.⟦MSBT:0E000000020002006400⟧
EU_Italian:
⟦MSBT:0E000000020002005F00⟧Gli Abitanti del Cielo patirono
a lungo le crudeltà della malvagia regina.⟦MSBT:0E000000020002006400⟧
EU_Spanish:
⟦MSBT:0E000000020002006200⟧Hacía mucho que los habitantes de los
cielos sufrían la crueldad de la reina.⟦MSBT:0E000000020002006400⟧
KR_Korean:
오랫 동안 이 나라는
사악한 여왕에게 고통받고 있었습니다.
TR_Turkish:
Gökyüzü Halkı, kötü kraliçenin
zalimliği altında uzun süre yaşadı.

label: Ending_02
EU_English:
In a last-ditch effort to
save themselves
EU_French:
Dans un effort désespéré
pour échapper à leur sort...
EU_German:
In einem letzten verzweifelten
Versuch, sich zu retten,
EU_Italian:
In un ultimo disperato
tentativo di salvarsi...
EU_Spanish:
En un último y desesperado intento
por salvarse,
TR_Turkish:
Kendilerini kurtarmak için
son bir çareye başvurdular.

label: Ending_03
EU_English:
t⟦MSBT:0E000000020002006400⟧hey put their hopes and dreams into
a seed and sent it to the surface⟦MSBT:0E000000020002006400⟧
EU_French:
⟦MSBT:0E000000020002005B00⟧... ils placèrent tous leurs espoirs dans

Umutlarını ve hayallerini bir tohuma

EU_English:
in order to bring Kirby, the hero of
Dream Land, to their rescue.

... afin d'appeler Kirby, le héros

um Kirby, den Helden des Dream
